boundary_note: Bounded first pass within the complete frozen 16-record Peninsula Campaign. Opening personnel and effective replacement boundaries remain unresolved. The combined VA020 and component VA020A/VA020B records overlap and cannot supply additive battle credit. Draft prose does not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. The frozen side-specific numerical bounds are blank; zero displays, vessel lists, combined army totals and later casualties cannot fill them.

claims.rationale: These are source fields, not matched opening returns. Preserve vessel versus personnel units, unspecified formations and combined versus side totals. Shared NPS/CWSAC provenance supplies no independent confirmation; displayed zeros are not measured absence.

claims.value: NPS places Magruder’s defenses behind the Warwick River.
claims.rationale: Source-described position only; fortification work may be commander-created, so no inherited terrain score is admitted.

citations.quote: Magruder's small Confederate army at Yorktown behind the Warwick River.

claims.value: Webb reproduces Keyes’s April 5 statement that wagons had not arrived and that he would need to halt for reserve infantry ammunition.
claims.rationale: Attributed quoted correspondence within a retrospective history; original message and receipt were not inspected. This is an approach constraint, not a readiness score or proof of the cause of the entire siege.

citations.locator: pp.44–45 (OCR page markers; not checked against print)
citations.quote: Our wagons did not arrive last night, and we shall be obliged to halt at Warwick Court House for the infantry reserve ammunition to come up.

claims.rationale: No original reconnaissance, order or message chain was inspected to establish the commanders’ contemporary knowledge. Retrospective explanations of beliefs, surprise or missed opportunities are not independently verified information states.

claims.value: NPS describes an advance toward Richmond being suspended for siege works and heavy guns.
claims.rationale: An operational sequence, not independently inspected original success criteria. The later withdrawal from Yorktown does not prove attainment of every intended objective.

citations.quote: McClellan suspended the march up the Peninsula toward Richmond, ordered the construction of siege fortifications, and brought his heavy siege guns to the front.

claims.value: NPS assigns the siege decision to McClellan, the initial Confederate position to Magruder, and reinforcement to Johnston.
claims.rationale: Different command roles, not equal outcome credit; no effective command-transfer clock is established.

citations.quote: Gen. Joseph E. Johnston brought reinforcements for Magruder.

claims.rationale: Retain the frozen outcome and engagement interval. A tactical result, later retreat, success at a local sector and campaign contribution are different measures. No causal effect, half-win or extra independent victory is inferred.

claims.rationale: Preserve source versions and population boundaries. No original return was inspected to reconcile totals, categories, missing side breakdowns or reporting cutoffs. open_questions: Original orders, personnel and casualty returns, contemporary message chains, disputed totals and precise command clocks remain deferred after the bounded follow-up. No OCR-to-print or map verification is claimed.
Keep opening, reinforced, engaged, hospital, captured and vessel populations distinct. Source fields and retrospective judgments do not establish causal contributions.
Preserve frozen outcomes and campaign membership, including combined/component rows; no automatic commander credit or battle/campaign double counting.
